disclosures.text: A measurement device for tree trunk diameter measurement
Mounted on a tree harvester
Measures tree trunks fed forwards in longitudinal direction
Includes first and second optical sensors
Each sensor integrated into a housing
Housing has viewing ports for emitted and reflected light
Each sensor includes a light source in the housing
Light source projects a patch of light onto the tree trunk
Each sensor includes an optical receiver
Optical receiver images the light patch on a position-sensitive photodetector
A pair of brackets supports the sensors
Brackets arranged on a harvester frame
Housing and sensors located on opposite sides of the tree trunk
Supplementary reference surface for diameter measurement
Reference surface defined by fixed knives of delimbing jaws
A slot-shaped compartment for sensor maintenance and control
Compartment limited by a protective cover/screen and an inner wall
Viewing ports arranged in the protective screen
Inner wall provided with protective glass
Protective glass forms viewing ports for the sensor optical system

A measurement device for a tree harvester comprising two optical sensors in housings with viewing ports, light sources, receivers, brackets, and a slot-shaped compartment for sensor maintenance defined by a screen with viewing ports and an
A climate-control unit generates forced air flow
Forced air flow has temperature exceeding surrounding atmosphere
Forced air flow passes through the slot-shaped compartment
A washing unit cleans optical components periodically
Washing unit applies washing fluid under pressure
Washing fluid applied to protective glass via spray nozzles
Spray nozzles arranged in the slot-shaped compartment
Each housing comprises a motor
Motor drives a wiper blade through a shaft
Wiper blade located in the slot-shaped compartment
Wiper blade sweeps across protective glass upon motor activation
Protective screen has drainage holes
Drainage holes lead fluid out from the slot-shaped compartment
Washing unit and climate-control unit form a functional-securing system
Functional-securing system mounted as a unit at the harvester
Viewing ports arranged separated from each other
Viewing ports preferably in groove-shaped indentations
First and second sensors arranged on diametrically opposite sides of tree trunk
Sensors and viewing ports oriented centrally with respect to each other
Sensors and viewing ports positioned in opposite parallel planes
Parallel planes for projecting light patch onto relevant half circumference of tree trunk
Light source and optical receiver located one after the other
Light source and receiver located in axial direction of bracket
Light source and receiver located in a direction out from tree feed pathway
